benchmark: Label robustness: Muse Spark (open) on the sample clips under several input conditions
reproduce: UNDERSTUDY_ENV_FILE=<path to .env.local> node scripts/bench-label.mjs --runs 5 --clips iss --conditions a,b,c,d,e,f,g --model meta-models/muse-spark-open

context.iss: aboard the ISS, plant growth experiment

task.iss: aboard the ISS, planting seed film into the Veggie plant pillows

conditions.prompt: LABEL_PROMPT of scripts/bench-session.mjs, verbatim; d adds one line saying the clip comes as captioned keyframes and a montage
conditions.thinking: off: {"reasoning_effort":"low"} (reasoning cannot be switched off (enable_thinking false made it longer; effort none is refused); off here means reasoning_effort low); f: the model's default
conditions.max_tokens: 8000 in every condition (its reasoning cannot be switched off)
conditions.order: run-major: run 1 of every clip and condition, then run 2, ...; sequential, one call at a time
conditions.retries: one retry after 5 s on a timeout, 429 or 5xx; none happened unless attempts > 1

iss:kf.note: 6 keyframes at the centres of 6 equal segments, JPEG q4; montage 12 frames 320 wide in a 4x3 tile

conditions.prices: list prices from tests/fixtures/models-compare.json ($1.25 in / $4.25 out per million); video tokens priced as prompt tokens; a failed or timed-out call is charged at its reserved worst case

iss.verb: some step has verb insert, or place with target.fixture pocket
iss.object: main object's name matches /seed|film|strip|tape/i and not /battery|drive|disk|hdd|ssd|cartridge|card|cell|module/i
iss.fixture: the first insert or place step's target.fixture is pocket
iss.size: main object's largest size_mm within a factor of 2 of 60 mm (30 to 120)
iss.diagnostic_scene: (not scored) some object name matches /pillow|plant|seed|veggie|root|growth/i and none matches /battery|hard.?drive|disk|hdd|ssd/i
